owner: Sun5SecondChecker (author); runtime lifecycle owned by the shared parent supervisor; nothing here launches anything

interpreter.version: CPython 3.14.3 (observed via run.json of the producer environment and Homebrew path; re-verify at GO)

command_template.note: --output-dir must not exist (checker mkdirs it; refuses existing). The supervisor creates OUT/runs/ and OUT/runs/tmp/ (new dirs) before the first run. PYTHONHASHSEED only fixes set iteration order for byte-identical records.tsv/RESULT ordering; results do not depend on it (records.tsv is in input-line order).

concurrency: one CPython child at a time; no helpers, threads, subprocesses, native code, NumPy/SciPy/LP

estimates.basis: [INFERENCE] static estimate from data-structure sizes and loop counts; NOT measured (no execution allowed while authoring)
estimates.per_run_wall_seconds: 5-60 expected; hard per-run deadline argument = start+900
estimates.per_run_peak_rss_bytes: expected <= 3.0e8 (owner array 8.5 MB, rank table 4.2 MB, 120 mask tables 0.25 MB, ~21k parsed records ~25-40 MB, input 0.64 MB); supervisor watch threshold 1.0e9 (no hard ulimit per contract)
estimates.per_run_output_bytes: records.tsv ~1.0e6, RESULT.json <=1.2e6 (failure list capped at 2000), COMPLETE.json <1e3, stderr <4e3

disk.launch_rule: fresh available >= 12.2e9 + 1.1e8 projected before the first run (contract launch_rule)

stopping.normal: checker exits after publishing COMPLETE.json; exit 0 only for pass_valid
stopping.deadline: checker polls deadline in every phase -> INCOMPLETE_DEADLINE (exit 2), never PASS
stopping.cancel: identity-checked SIGTERM from the shared supervisor (PID, pgid, cwd, argv hash recorded at launch) -> INCOMPLETE_CANCELLED (exit 3) after publishing partial accounting; bounded wait 60 s; no SIGKILL, no tool/subprocess timeout, no ulimit
stopping.unsettled: an unsettled child blocks further launches and is recorded UNKNOWN by the supervisor
